args.note: Wrote cold-read.md, a full cold read of all 54 pages. Verdicts: Issue 01 put down: none, next issue: yes. Issue 02 put down: page 20, next issue: no. Issue 03 put down: page 51, next issue: no. Main findings: Alpha and the Water War aren't explained until p41. Lina, Suri, Jalen and Ren are named on p22 before we ever meet them. Tomas's "SIGNAL LOST" on p18 contradicts p17, and nobody mentions him again until p52. Grandma's "closer than you think," the casino chip and the water-drop mark never pay off. The climax on pp49–51 is mostly screen text. Many characters talk in the same "X isn't Y" one-liners, which a skeptical class would read as AI-made. The strongest pages are p2, pp6–7, p15, pp38–40, p46 and p52.

args.note: Cold read complete: Issue 01 hooked (62/18 reveal landed, verdict: next issue yes), Issue 02 dragged hardest at the four identical collaborator errands (would have put it down page 25), Issue 03 had the best scenes (Ada/Leona, the executive refusal) but the procedure pages lost me (page 50) and the ending closes rather than pulls — no next book. Flagged the unexplained-terms ledger (Alpha, Covenant, Seal, Measure), the VEY/VEYRA name collision, the vanishing Grandmother, the 94→91% drop and the debt math.
